title: The Fourth, 2013
logline: Gully's dock. Gully has a kid on his shoulders — his own, this time. Wood draws the fireworks white and the kid's balloon red.

panels.composition: The dock, night, crowded, white fireworks on blue. GULLY with a small child on his shoulders — his, a girl, three. MARIA beside with a second, a baby. WOOD on the steps with BARNABY.
props: a red balloon on the child's wrist

image.prompt: a crowded dock at night under white fireworks on a deep blue watercolor sky, a stocky man with a small girl on his shoulders, a woman beside him holding a baby, a thin man on shack steps with an old dog, a single red balloon tied to the girl's wrist

panels.composition: The girl on Gully's shoulders, pointing at the fireworks, saying the only word the strip gives her.

image.prompt: close-up of a small girl on a man's shoulders pointing up at fireworks, delighted

panels.composition: Gully, to Wood, over the crowd.

image.prompt: a stocky man with a child on his shoulders calling to a thin man on shack steps, fireworks light

panels.composition: The finale. White on blue. The one red thing: the girl's balloon. The lawn chair out in the open where Maria dragged it in 2009, Maria in it with the baby.

characters.pose: in the lawn chair with the baby

image.prompt: a fireworks finale in white over a blue night bay above a crowded dock, a single red balloon, and under a shack's eave an old lawn chair with a woman sitting in it holding a baby, watercolor, no words
image.notes: The chair has been Maria's since 2009 (dw_2009-07-04). The baby is new.

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Gully's kids. The chair Maria's, with the baby now. 'Not in hers.'
